fields.title: Filter rows without missing values
fields.description: If checked, only rows containing missing values will be in the output table.

fields.title: Column name suffix
fields.description: The new columns containing the extracted error message will be labeled with this suffix.

fields.title: Column selection
fields.description:
Select the columns from which to extract error messages of missing values. Only the error messages of the
included columns will be extracted.
